A FEW THINGS YOU MAY WONDER

A little clarity.
Before we begin.

What can we book Lifeshots for?

Wedding and pre-wedding photography, fashion and celebrity portraits, baby and maternity shoots, and videography. Tell us about your occasion so the team can discuss the right coverage.

Where is the team based?

The main office is in Punjab, with a branch in Kangra, Himachal Pradesh. Share your venue and travel plans when you inquire.

How do we check dates and pricing?

Send your date, location, and the type of shoot using the inquiry form, or call +91 94655 73973. Availability, packages, deliverables, and timelines are confirmed directly by the team.
